Name: EMC-error fix for android
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[code]EMC Automate Compatibility (Android)

A small Android compatibility bridge for Extra Machine Config (EMC) + Automate.

What it does
------------
The Android EMC build targeted by this mod uses an outdated Automate output callback. This bridge suppresses that incompatible callback at runtime and installs the corrected three-argument callback instead.

It does not replace or modify Extra Machine Config itself.

This is a focused compatibility fix only. It is not a general Android port of EMC and it does not claim to fix unrelated EMC/Android issues.

Requirements
------------
- Stardew Valley 1.6 on Android
- SMAPI for Android 4.1.10+
- Extra Machine Config 1.17.1-unofficial.3-android
- Automate 2.5.0 or a compatible later version

Installation
------------
1. Fully close Stardew Valley and SMAPI.
2. Delete any older/test EMCAutomateCompatibility folder.
3. Keep Extra Machine Config and Automate installed normally.
4. Extract EMCAutomateCompatibility into your Mods folder.
5. Launch through SMAPI.

Uninstall
---------
Delete the EMCAutomateCompatibility folder. It does not alter the files in your EMC installation.

Credits and permission
----------------------
- selph (Selph aka zombifier): Extra Machine Config and the corrected callback code this bridge is based on. Shared with the original author's permission.
- Pathoschild: Automate.
- KhaStark: Android compatibility bridge/package.

Troubleshooting
---------------
If it still fails, reproduce the issue and include a fresh SMAPI-latest.txt together with your Stardew Valley, Android SMAPI, EMC, and Automate versions when reporting it.[/code]
